headline: OKX Raises at $25B Valuation as Crypto Longs Liquidate
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange OKX secured funding at a $25 billion valuation from Circle, Ripple, and Standard Chartered, as a market selloff triggered over $500 million in long liquidations.
why: OKX is one of the world's largest digital asset exchanges. Heavy futures liquidations often accelerate short-term volatility across crypto markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Widespread liquidations of leveraged long contracts accelerated downward selling pressure.

why_moved: A sharp late-evening selloff forced the liquidation of over $500 million in leveraged crypto long positions.
